summary: Plan explicit existing managed-target ownership in native upgrades

delivery.outcome: Let exact read-only native upgrade plans acknowledge existing newly managed governance files using the existing managedTargetTakeovers contract, preserving every actual ownership and publication gate.
nonGoals: Transfer foreign workstream or live writer ownership
Consumer adoption, legacy deletion, IMG or PyPI deployment

architecture.decision: Validate an explicit bounded external base/source/path/digest acknowledgment against committed regular-file state and existing governance ownership; embed existing managedTargetTakeovers in the native allocation plan and independently recompute it under the existing allocator lock.
interfaceChanges: Optional --upgrade-ownership-plan for read-only published native allocation planning
dataChanges: Existing standardAdoption.managedTargetTakeovers bindings; no new authority
architecture.rollback: Revert the scoped capability through protected review and retain immutable135 and consumer managed pins.

validation.evidence: Real Git positive/default refusal and stale, foreign, mode, malformed, path and publication negatives.
Native allocator recomputation carries exact acknowledgment into intent/lease and refuses tampering before reservation.
Required source checks, full Goal tests and independent exact-head Validator before immutable136 release.
